chapter_seo_title: Burial Shroud of Suiren & King Ship Summoning - World of Immortality Ch. 119
chapter_meta_description: The little defiant dragon retrieves Suiren's burial shroud. The Demon returns the sacred tree and begins a 7-day ritual to summon the King Ship. Yin energies and ghostly wails gather on the beach.
og_title: The Shroud of Suiren and the King Ship's Summoning
og_description: Xiao Chen and Yan Qingcheng shelter under the ancestral shroud as the demon summons the King Ship with a terrifying ritual. The departure from Dragon Island draws near.
twitter_description: A blood-stained shroud may be from Suiren himself. The demon begins a seven-day summoning ritual, filling the sky with nether energies. Escape is not yet secured.
